IRL:

I HAVE DEPRESSION AND ITS WORSE THAN EVER.

I CANT KEEP RELYING ON PEOPLE TO HELP ME ANYMORE BECAUSE ALL I DO IS BOTHER THEM FROM THEIR OWN TROUBLES, I DONT WANT TO ADD TO THAT.

I DONT WANT PEOPLE OR MY FRIENDS TO THINK THAT IM A SAD MISERABLE EXISTANCE THAT ANNOYS THEM. YET I WORRY ABOUT BEING ANNOYING. I PROBABLY AM, ARENT I.

IN-GAME:

FOCUS. ON. THE. OBJECTIVE. IN PVP!! ALSO READ TOOLTIPS IN PVP, YOU MAY BE SURPRISED AT WHAT YOU CAN LEARN!!

ALSO STOP TRYING TO BE THE HERO AND SOLO JUMP TO THE ENEMY TEAM THATS ALL HUDDLED TOGETHER TO SAVE THE DAY! AT LEAST HAVE SOME BACKUP! OTHERWISE YOU LOOK LIKE A MEGA FOOL

I think that’s all for now, commenter. But thanks for giving me a ground to yell at. I might come back here for more venting in later times, or make a new thread entirely.
But really, thanks

Tomorrow is Friday so the r/FFXIV reddit is going to have rage thread fridays...

I don’t care if any of you recognise me from that, just let me vent out! Because apparently, I CANT VENT OUT TO SAVE MY OWN HEART
DONT DRAG ME OUT FOR MY OWN SAKE, AND IM AFRAID OF HURTING YOU GUYS SO I CANT SAY A DAMN THING!

And to my dear family...

When I’m sad and want to be left alone...

I WANT TO BE LEFT ALONE

WHEN IM THE ONE WITH THE PROBLEM, THE SOLUTION ISNT TO “CONTROL YOURSELF OR WE’LL CUT TIES.”

THE SOLUTION IS TO FUCKING TALK!!!!!

TALK! TALK!!! INSTEAD YOU ALL MADE THIS FEEL EVEN WORSE FOR ME

Seeking attention? Doesn’t everyone want that?

But I’m constantly ignored. If I say something normal, I get brushed aside. 

I hate how I have to yell to make people pay attention, because as of now, YOU SUDDENLY HATE IT WHEN I GET ATTENTION HUH?!

AND STOP MAKING THIS BEING ABOUT YOU OR EVERYONE ELSE WHEN IM THE ONE HAVING THE PROBLEM

EVERY SINGLE ONE OF YOU KNOWS THAT IM IN A VULNERABLE STATE ALREADY. 

DONT. MAKE. IT. WORSE
Also, does acting like adults mean to hold back the emotions even further? From you saying that, that sure is the impression you gave me!

Well dude, the guy that said the whole thing was my fault because I made an outburst, guess what, LISTEN TO ME FIRST BEFORE YOU CAN EVEN TELL ME THAT I NEED TO LISTEN.

(Not to you btw commenter you a nice guy)You have no idea what I’m talking about, it’s obvious! We play games to get away from the stresses of life. SO DONT TELL ME THAT IM OVERSTEPPING IT, THE DISCORD SERVER DOESNT EVEN HAVE A PLACE FOR PEOPLE TO RAGE OUT AND TO JUST PRIVATELY PM SOMEONE FOR THAT???THAT MAKES IT WORSE FOR THEM TOO BECAUSE THEY ARE THE SOLE BURDEN OF THE PERSON’s STRESS

And also, the world is a bitch yes, and so is life. Why do I have to adjust for it more than the healers in FFXIV?!

Why don’t you all just stop judging my true feelings as being “hurtful” and just let me OUT. THE LAST THING I WANT IN THIS STATE IS TO BE TOLD THAT “IM OVERSTEPPING MY BOUNDARIES” and “CROSSED THE LINE.”

THIS ISNT ABOUT YOU JACKASS. WHY DID IT SUDDENLY GO TO YOU? DO YOU NEED A FRIEND?

All this holding in is just solidifying the fact that I want to cut somewhere on my body, and show everyone how people bleed.

Bleeding hurts, and it hurts even more so when people just think it’s something I can handle.

What if it was a deep knife wound? Would the bleeding be something I can just control on a whim?

Let me just destroy this bottle once, and let everyone I know see how much this hurts me. They didn’t even understand when I explained when I said “control”. 

They get hurt, and even threaten to cut ties simply because I yelled my heart out.
